## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Biotech]** **Engineered molecular glue stabilizes aging chromosomes** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/26/fertility-advance-engineered-protein-stabilizes-chromosomes-in-aging-eggs/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Researchers have engineered a protein system functioning as a molecular glue capable of restoring normal chromosome connections in aging mouse eggs.
  * The advance raises translational prospects for eventually improving in vitro fertilization (IVF) outcomes.

* **[Biotech]** **Endothelium-released Dll4 identified as sarcopenia driver** [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.25.769149)
  * Soluble, full-length Delta-like ligand 4 (Dll4) released from endothelial cells was identified as a common driver of both primary and secondary sarcopenia by activating Notch2.
  * Sustained Dll4 inhibition attenuated primary sarcopenia, preserved vascular integrity, ameliorated systemic aging phenotypes, and extended lifespan in aged mice.

* **[Biotech]** **Mice study links malaria and LPS to thyroid disruption** [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.24.768855)
  * Pregnant mice infected with *Plasmodium berghei* ANKA or challenged with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) showed increased maternal serum TSH and reduced fetal weight.
  * Malaria in pregnancy (MiP) reduced Slc7a8 mRNA and Dio2 mRNA while altering MCT8 and MCT10 placental immunostaining across sexes.

* **[Biotech]** **Semenogelin-1 domains inhibit CatSper channel** [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.09.05.674523)
  * Full-length recombinant mouse Semenogelin-1 (mSEMG1) and truncated fragments mSEMG1Q32-V118 and mSEMG1R98-G375 inhibited sperm progressive motility, hyperactivation, and reduced CatSper currents.
  * Electrophysiological recordings indicate the effect occurs downstream of capacitation-associated intracellular alkalinization.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **First-in-human in vivo CAR-T data previewed for ASH 2026** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2126297848576684131)
  * Early clinical data for B-cell lymphomas to be presented at ASH 2026 show objective response rates (ORR) for in vivo CAR-T candidates: Simnova (anti-CD19) at 83% (n=6), Iaso (anti-CD20) at 87% (n=8), and Umoja (anti-CD22) at 44% (n=9).
  * Legend Biotech will also present an update on LB2501 in a poster session.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **Discussion on PSMAddition trial in mHSPC** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)02003-9/fulltext?rss=yes)
  * Correspondence highlights the Phase 3 PSMAddition trial evaluating [¹⁷⁷Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 added to androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) and an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.
  * Commentators noted a significant radiographic progression-free survival benefit (HR 0.72; 95% CI 0.58–0.90), while questioning optimal treatment duration and control-arm chemotherapy combinations.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA extends assessment of Vertex kidney drug** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/27/stat-fda-extends-assessment-of-experimental-vertex-kidney-drug/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * The FDA extended its review period for Vertex's investigational kidney drug, povetacicept, amid agency inquiries regarding potential safety concerns.

- Biology & Health
    - [The Government Is Getting AI Wrong](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3SEgK7RcS2M) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Sergei Polevikov discusses the integration of AI as an essential component of modern healthcare systems.
        - He argues that traditional physician credentialing methods may be inadequate for the reality of clinical AI.
        - Promoting artificial intelligence implementations based on the results of a single study creates a flawed foundational approach for medical adoption.
    - [I Wouldn't Bet on OpenAI](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5YyT1tsJ9Gc) -- Health2Tech
        - Bret Waters analyzes why being a first mover in the artificial intelligence sector fails to guarantee ultimate market victory.
        - He notes that raising the largest amount of capital does not ensure long-term success for prominent organizations like OpenAI.
        - The competitive AI landscape involves multiple major players, including Anthropic, Google Gemini, and DeepSeek, alongside OpenAI.
    - [Raising the Most Money Doesn't Mean Winning](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/0tPClsjBXPc) -- Health2Tech
        - Bret Waters explains that securing massive venture capital and raising the most money can intimidate competing market entrants.
        - High funding totals and large capital reserves do not translate into superior operational outcomes or sustainable market leadership.
        - Startup funding strategies and founder mindsets must account for the reality that capital alone does not secure business longevity.
- Pure Science
    - [De quoi seront faites les batteries du futur ? [Le PEPR Batteries]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EWgTHGFVvmI) -- ScienceEtonnante
        - While Lithium-ion technology currently dominates the energy storage landscape, active research is underway to develop the next generation of batteries.
        - The video explores the underlying electrochemistry governing modern battery systems.
        - The PEPR Batteries initiative funds and supports research projects and technological developments aimed at shaping future battery chemistries.
